UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 2, dark): the persistent cart store. Migration 20270346039000_commerce_carts.sql adds public.commerce_carts (one row per buyer, profile_id primary key, lines jsonb array capped at 50, service role only, RLS on with no policy) with a pgTAP guard in supabase/tests/commerce_carts.test.sql. lib/commerce/cart-store.ts loads (through parseCart), saves, adds, sets, removes and merges a guest cart; app/(main)/marketplace/cart-actions.ts exposes them behind COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED (blank = dark, gate in RUNBOOKS 'Persistent cart'); an Add to cart button sits beside Buy now on /market/<id> only when the switch is on. Still open: checkout from a saved cart, a /cart page, prune-on-read against live stock, P3 shipping profiles and P4 facets (Packet G UI). Daniel applies the SQL in Frequency Community after merge. UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P3/P4 fixture UI, Packet G, dark): components/marketplace/etsy-preview.tsx is a read-only shipping-options display plus labelled kit controls for category, tag, condition, price, seller type and sort, owned by a fixture caller and covered by etsy-preview.test.tsx. No live listing query, shipping quote, cart wiring or checkout is attached; the public product page still reads nothing from it. UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 3, dark): the /cart page (app/(main)/cart/page.tsx, standard Index shell and rail). It lists the saved lines with the live product or variant price, says what is no longer for sale or was lowered to stock (lib/commerce/cart-view.ts, display only, nothing written back), and lets the buyer change quantity or remove a line. It answers 404 until COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED is set. Still open: checkout from the saved cart, live shipping quotes, and writing pruned lines back. UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 4, dark): checkout from the saved cart behind COMMERCE_CART_CHECKOUT_ENABLED (needs the cart switch). startCartCheckoutAction (app/(main)/marketplace/cart-actions.ts) loads the stored cart through lib/commerce/cart-load.ts (the same door /cart reads), prices and prunes it from the live rows, and pays it through createCommerceCheckout unchanged, so the existing one-seller and multi-seller funds flows apply. components/marketplace/cart-checkout.tsx is the Check out control on /cart (on-page card form, hosted fallback); the cart is emptied after the on-page payment settles. Still open: a Stripe test-mode run of a two-seller cart, emptying the cart on the hosted return, live shipping quotes.

2026-11-16 (SCAN-1207): this row was unparked 2026-09-28 (ADR-1535) and is no longer deferred; its evidence line is the current one. Re-test what shipped in lib/marketplace before working it.\n\nUPDATE 2026-11-16 (P5 slice 5, dark): the saved cart now follows what was paid and what the buyer was told, behind the same two switches (COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED, COMMERCE_CART_CHECKOUT_ENABLED), with no migration. What was paid for leaves the cart on the pending to paid flip in recordCommerceOrderFromSession (lib/commerce/checkout.ts), so the Stripe webhook, the hosted return on /orders and the on-page settle all do it, once: only the rows that flip returned are acted on, the order's own items are taken out by quantity (lib/commerce/cart.ts takeOutPaid, cart-store.ts takePaidOutOfStoredCart), a line added while paying stays, guest orders are skipped, and a failed cart write is logged and never fails the settlement. A line that is no longer for sale or was lowered to stock is saved that way the first time the buyer is told (lib/commerce/cart-load.ts loadCartView through cart-store.ts savePrunedCart, which only drops or lowers); the reads behind it are strict (products.ts getProductsStrict, getVariantsByIds strict) so a failed read throws instead of emptying a cart, and startCartCheckoutAction charges nothing and asks the buyer to look again when the cart changed at pay time. Tested with mocks only. Still open: a Stripe test-mode run of a two-seller cart, live shipping quotes.

UPDATE 2026-11-16 (P5 slice 6, dark): the cart says who sells what and what checkout will do, behind the same two switches, with no migration and no change to the checkout door. lib/commerce/cart-plan.ts (pure) groups the priced lines by seller and asks the door's own seams (funds-flow planFundsFlow, selling canTakePayments, shipping cartNeedsShipping), and buildCartView carries the answer as view.checkout. /cart (components/marketplace/cart-sellers.tsx) lists each seller's lines under the seller's name with a subtotal, says that several sellers are paid in one go and that an address is asked for on the secure payment page when something ships, and for a cart the door would refuse (two currencies, Frequency Store items with another seller's, a contact-only seller) says why and shows no Check out control. A product with options now offers Add to cart for the chosen option (components/marketplace/variant-picker.tsx), which it never did. The plan cannot see a seller's plan gate or Stripe readiness; the door still refuses those in its own words. Tested with mocks only. Still open: a Stripe test-mode run of a two-seller cart (needs Stripe access); P3 seller shipping profiles and a shipping line on the order (needs a migration); P4 facets on the live Market query; P6 order messaging; P7 storing and applying discount codes, payout reporting and tax posture.
